what: The public change log of /vp-vnp/: one dated entry per change of the page or of its state. The builder refuses when the newest entry’s state is not the records’.

entries.what: The page opens, public and listed: the pre-registration sealed at 23:57 UTC on 23 November (its rows, its verdict rule and the release's own gaps, timestamped before any run); phase 1 started on a rented machine at 00:03 UTC on 24 November; writer B's blind statement sealed at 00:03 UTC; writer A and the adversarial reader at work.

Phase 1 under way: every file of the release matched its pin, Mathlib was fetched and the build is running. Both blind statements are written and sealed before elaboration: writer B (GPT-6.2-astra) at 00:03 UTC, writer A (Claude) at 00:12 UTC.

Fifteen of 23 rows have passed. Phase 1: the release's own check, nanoda at a second version and con-leche accept the five theorems; both planted controls are refused by two checkers each; the census and the paper's Table 3 match the Lean. Phase 2: both blind statements elaborated with no repair; both are proved from the release's theorems, and Comparator accepts each bridge with our blind statement as the challenge; the anchors hold and the planted dense-power claim is proved false; the adversarial reading found nothing material and its Lean tests are proved. Running: Lean's from-scratch replays and a second, fresh machine. The rows card is now one column. Corrections D1–D3 added.

VERDICT: CERTIFIED, by the rule sealed before any run (the formal claim, as the textbooks define it). The last required row passed: Lean's own checker replayed the whole closure from scratch (35 min, exit 0). With it: the release's own check, nanoda at a second version and con-leche accept the proof; a second machine that never ran the release's proofs accepts it too; both planted controls are refused; both blind statements are proved from the release's theorems, with Comparator accepting each against our statement; the anchors hold and the planted false claim is proved false; the adversarial reading found nothing material. No person has checked the mathematics. Phase 3 (Remark N.6) and the readable account continue.

The three seals are in Bitcoin: the pre-registration and writer B's blind statement in block 977295 (00:19 UTC, 24 Nov), writer A's blind statement in block 977301 (01:10 UTC); each proof's merkle root equals the block header's. Lean's own checker also replayed both bridges from scratch, exit 0 (36 min each).

Phase 3 has begun. Remark N.6 is written as a Lean statement, elaborated at the release's pins and sealed before any proof (SEAL-2, 02:38 UTC); two provers that do not see each other are working on the determinant's circuit, and nothing is proved yet. Row NC passed, 18 of 23: the proof's constant is c = 1/1600² and it gives no value for m₀, read from the Lean and the paper line by line (a reading, not a machine check).

Correction D4: the page said the rows were timestamped in Bitcoin before any of them ran. The stamp was submitted at 23:57 UTC, before any run, but its Bitcoin block is 977295 (00:19 UTC on 24 Nov), by which time rows PIN and K0 had finished. The chain fixes the rule before every other result and before the verdict; for PIN and K0, and for the order of writer A's blind statement and its bridge, the evidence is our own log. No result changes.
